title: 90% Write Power-Saving SRAM Using Sense-Amplifying Memory Cell
figure_number: Fig. 4. Write voltage generator design. (a) Circuit diagram. (b) Output voltage fluctuation against V variations.
function_summary: 90% Write Power-Saving SRAM: This paper describes a low-power write scheme which reduces SRAM power by 90% by using seven-transistor sense-amplifying memory cells.
